passages.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines before Pharaoh struck down Gaza.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message about the Philistines.
This happened before Pharaoh attacked Gaza.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֧ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֶל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים בְּטֶ֛רֶם יַכֶּ֥ה פַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת־ עַזָּֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “See how the waters are rising from the north and becoming an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and its fullness, the cities and their inhabitants. The people will cry out, and all who dwell in the land will wail at the sound of the galloping hooves of stallions, the rumbling of chariots, and the clatter of their wheels. The fathers will not turn back for their sons; their hands will hang limp.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
He says these words.
Waters are rising from the north.
These waters become a strong, overflowing torrent.
The waters will cover the land.
They will fill the land completely.
They will flood the cities.
They will reach everyone who lives there.
People will cry out in fear.
Everyone living in the land will wail.
They will hear the sound of galloping horses.
They will hear the rumbling of chariots.
They will hear the clatter of wheels.
Fathers will not turn back to help their sons.
Their hands will hang limp with fear.
passages.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנֵּה־ מַ֜יִם עֹלִ֤ים מִצָּפוֹן֙ וְהָיוּ֙ לְנַ֣חַל שׁוֹטֵ֔ף וְיִשְׁטְפוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֔הּ עִ֖יר וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְזָֽעֲקוּ֙ הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְהֵילִ֕ל כֹּ֖ל יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃ מִקּ֗וֹל שַֽׁעֲטַת֙ פַּרְס֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔יו מֵרַ֣עַשׁ לְרִכְבּ֔וֹ הֲמ֖וֹן גַּלְגִּלָּ֑יו לֹֽא־ הִפְנ֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ אֶל־ בָּנִ֔ים מֵֽרִפְי֖וֹן יָדָֽיִם׃

passages.text: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every remaining ally. Indeed, the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet.
The LORD gave a message about the Philistines.
The LORD said a day is coming.
On that day, the LORD will destroy all the Philistines.
The LORD will remove every ally who helps Tyre and Sidon.
The LORD will destroy the Philistines.
The Philistines are the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
passages.original: עַל־ הַיּ֗וֹם הַבָּא֙ לִשְׁד֣וֹד אֶת־ כָּל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְהַכְרִ֤ית לְצֹר֙ וּלְצִיד֔וֹן כֹּ֖ל שָׂרִ֣יד עֹזֵ֑ר כִּֽי־ שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שְׁאֵרִ֖ית אִ֥י כַפְתּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking about the people of Gaza and Ashkelon.
The people of Gaza will shave their heads.
They will do this because they are mourning.
Ashkelon will become silent.
The remnant of their valley will remain.
You, remnant of the valley, are left.
How long will you continue to wound yourself?
passages.original: בָּ֤אָה קָרְחָה֙ אֶל־ עַזָּ֔ה נִדְמְתָ֥ה אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית עִמְקָ֑ם עַד־ מָתַ֖י תִּתְגּוֹדָֽדִי׃ס

passages.text: ‘Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still!’
passages.sermon:
The sword belongs to the LORD.
The sword brings destruction.
People cry out to the sword.
They ask, "How long will you keep striking?"
They say, "Return to your sheath."
They say, "Stop your attack."
They say, "Be still and rest."
passages.original: ה֗וֹי חֶ֚רֶב לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַד־ אָ֖נָה לֹ֣א תִשְׁקֹ֑טִי הֵאָֽסְפִי֙ אַל־ תַּעְרֵ֔ךְ הֵרָגְעִ֖י וָדֹֽמִּי׃

passages.text: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? He has appointed it against Ashkelon and the shore of its coastland.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has given a command.
He has commanded the sword to act.
The sword cannot rest.
The LORD has sent the sword against Ashkelon.
He has also sent it against the shore of the sea.
The LORD has chosen these places for judgment.
passages.original: אֵ֣יךְ תִּשְׁקֹ֔טִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה צִוָּה־ לָ֑הּ אֶֽל־ אַשְׁקְל֛וֹן וְאֶל־ ח֥וֹף הַיָּ֖ם שָׁ֥ם יְעָדָֽהּ׃ס
